operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Fetch a single record of any entity, addressed by its `entityKey` and primary key `id`.

This is a generic, metadata-driven endpoint: the returned record's columns are defined per entity, so the field set differs by `entityKey`. The record's own columns appear at the top level and related data is nested under the relation name.

When the entity has custom fields, the matching custom-fields row is included under `custom_data`.

**Authentication & authorization.** Requires an OAuth2 Bearer token and the entity's **view** permission; otherwise the request is rejected with `401`.

parameters.name: dataLevel
parameters.description: Depth of related/nested data to load. Optional; defaults to `1`. A non-numeric value is treated as `1`. For single-page-app entities a suitable level is chosen automatically when omitted.

200.description: Success. The single record: the entity's own columns at the top level, related data nested under relation names, and an optional `custom_data` object. The exact field set depends on the entity.

schema.description: The record. Top-level keys are the entity's fields (entity-specific).

custom_data.description: Custom-fields row for the record; present only when the entity defines custom fields.

401.description: The caller does not hold the entity's view permission.

500.description: Returned when the record cannot be loaded (including a non-existent `id`). The body is the plain text `error happened`.
